title: UN Comtrade: annual exports of iron ore, coal and grains to every partner since 1980 (net weight)
licence: UN Comtrade public data; free for non-commercial use with attribution (see Comtrade terms of use)
coverage: SITC Revision 2 1980 to 1995; HS as reported 1988 to 2025
units: kilograms (netWgt); values in current US dollars (primaryValue)
limitations: Reporters enter the record in different years (HS from 1988 to 1993; the United States from 1981, Brazil from 1983 in SITC Revision 2; Ukraine from 1996); annual changes are measured on the reporters present in both years.
SITC Revision 2 groups differ slightly from the HS headings (other cereals include rye and oats); changes are always measured within one classification.
Partners that no longer exist (USSR, the two German states, Yugoslavia) are mapped to a successor's ports for distances.
Mode of transport is not separated, so exports to land neighbours are excluded by route design.
Russian exporter records are not used (Russia reports only from 1996 and stopped in 2022); Russian coal is measured from Indian and Japanese import records.
